label: r4_ve_exp3parity_s0_ep190_r2_a1random_a2rl_es0_r4ve
config_content:
# P0-2 (research_plan_v4_v5.md Sec.P0-2): identical to r4_ve.yml EXCEPT the
# runner. r4_ve.yml uses PredictionFeaturePredictionRunner, which (a) detaches
# ss/os before predict_feature so L_feat_other never reaches VE, and (b) masks
# vision at p_mask_vision=0.99 (1% leak). The original paper's exp3 (adding MG)
# uses MotionGenerationPredictionFeaturePredictionRunner: NO detach (FPM_other
# gradient flows FPM -> os -> SM -> generator) and full masking (p=1.0 for t>0).
# This config makes v4's VE receive the exact same training signal the paper's
# MG did, so an R4 failure here is attributable to the mechanism, not the build.
model:
    name: SuperpositionNetworkProbeQValueEstimation
    config: default
    mode: ~
runner: MotionGenerationPredictionFeaturePredictionRunner
data:
    name: r2_a1random_a2rl
load_state_dict_strict: False
p_mask_vision: 0.99  # ignored by MotionGeneration* runner (it forces p=1 for t>0)
train:
    loss_function: l1_loss
    pretrain:
        exp_config: r3_a_direct_1000pretrain
        seed: 0
        epoch: 200
    batch_size: 10
    max_epochs: 200
    save_interval: 10
    test_interval: 10
    optimizer: AdamW
    optim_config:
        default:
            lr: 0.001
            weight_decay: 0.01
        freeze:
            - vision_encoder_module
            - vision_decoder_module
            - integration_module
            - feature_prediction_module
            - share_lns
            - probe_critic
            - superposition_module
        per_params:
            - name: bias
              args:
                  weight_decay: 0.0
